results.description: Chat is the first primary navigation entry above Agents
Clicking Chat opens the New chat composer
New chat defaults: last agent, remembered model, temp workspace
Model picker shows quick picks, runtime rail and runtime-scoped models
Browsing a not-yet-loaded runtime shows loading then models
Unavailable runtime explains why and offers no models
Search spans runtimes and groups results by runtime
Choosing a search result updates the pill and closes the picker
Reasoning effort changes in place
Agent picker lists agents; agent default model is applied
Workspace picker: temp default, existing folders, open another folder
Quick pick restores a recent runtime+model in one click
Sending the first message starts a chat run and opens it
Mid-chat picker keeps the runtime and switches the model
Workspace panel is hidden by default and opens on demand
Save setup as agent dialog previews agent, skills and model
Existing chats reopen from the Chats list
Agents catalog is unchanged and still reachable
Catalog error shows retry and recovers
First run: no chats, no quick picks, AutoByteus default model
Narrow: composer controls wrap without overflow; picker fits the viewport
